Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring a competitive bid process on certain state construction projects.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to subcontracts on public construction projects;adding a new section to chapter 43.19 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that the bundling ofstate contracts provides an impediment for many of the state's smallbusinesses to compete for state contracts. The legislature furtherfinds that the development of the state's economy depends on thenurturing and growth of the state's small businesses.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 43.19 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The department shall require the competitive bidding of allsubcontracts on public construction projects of at least ten milliondollars that are awarded to general contractors based on a competitivebid process. (2) The department shall work with general contractors onadvertising subcontract bid opportunities to Washington businesses,including providing access to the state contractor prequalification p. 1 HB 2372list and the office of minority and women's business enterprisescertified minority and women's businesses list.
